title: GPS corrections settings
description: The settings object of the built-in maths module esses.gps_corrections, version 1 (03_MATHS_ENGINE.md section 9.2, D-016, D-027): project.json builtinMaths["esses.gps_corrections"].settings and the settings of a builtin item in a sidecar's localMaths. It is a member of those documents, not a document, so it carries no $schema or schemaVersion. Every member is optional and an absent member takes the module default. From M2 the module applies only its zero-fix step (latitude and longitude both exactly 0 are invalid), whatever the item's enabled flag says; statusChannel, duplicateRemoval and timeShift are validated and kept for the v1.0 correction steps.

additionalChannels.description: Further GPS channels the v1.0 time shift moves with latitude and longitude.

statusChannel.description: A receiver status channel and the comparison that makes a sample valid (v1.0).

validWhen.description: A comparison operator and a number, such as ">= 4".

duplicateRemoval.description: Replace runs of repeated samples by interpolation (v1.0).

timeShift.description: Shift the GPS channels earlier by a share of the update period, or by seconds (v1.0).

outputs.description: shadow: the corrected channels replace the inputs (self-maths); prefix: new channels named with the prefix.

gpsChannelName.description: A channel name as the layer spells it (looked up case-insensitively).
